card.name: Possessive and word parts in media titles
card.fires_on: Small words and word endings inside references to magazines, journals, and children's media, such as the 's in Children's, "in" before a magazine name, and parts of periodical titles.

modes.label: Children's possessive
modes.description: The 's or ’s right after the word Children in titles of media research or organisations.
modes.example: Representing Traumatic Events in Children<<’s>> News (AHRC)

modes.label: Periodical and journal names
modes.description: Word parts inside the names of journals, magazines, or periodical types.

modes.label: Linking word before a publication
modes.description: The word in or a media noun just before a named magazine or publication.
modes.example: A survey called “Now for the Truth About Americans and Sex," by Philip Elmer-Dewitt that was published<< in>> Time magazine in 1994

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated foreign fragments, and the suppressed ones are circ- and motion words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on small pieces of text in citations of magazines, journals, and children's media.
